Lesson Goals
🎯 By the End of This Lesson…
ستتمكن من تحقيق هذه الأهداف بنهاية الدرس
  • 1
    Name different types of clothing in English (tie, shirt, jacket, pants, dress, abaya…)
    تسمية أنواع الملابس المختلفة بالإنجليزية
  • 2
    Identify and name colors in English (blue, red, dark green, beige, purple…)
    التعرف على الألوان وتسميتها بالإنجليزية
  • 3
    Use "going to" to talk about future plans
    استخدام "going to" للحديث عن الخطط المستقبلية
  • 4
    Answer comprehension questions about a dialogue (Yes / No)
    الإجابة على أسئلة الاستيعاب بنعم أو لا
  • 5
    Ask and answer questions about clothes and colors (Pair Work)
    طرح الأسئلة والإجابة عنها في نشاط العمل الثنائي

👔 Clothes

🎨 Colors

blue, light blue, green, dark green, red, pink, purple, orange, yellow, brown, beige, black, gray, white

📖 Grammar

Subject + am/is/are + going to + verb
"I'm going to wear a jacket."

💬 Dialogue

Steve is traveling to Rio. Nawal is going to a wedding. Sabah is going shopping for a formal dress.

👥 Pair Work

Ask about clothes needed for different cities and seasons in Saudi Arabia.

✅ Quick Check

4 Yes/No comprehension questions about the dialogue.

Challenge
🏆 Challenge Question

🌍 Think & Write!

Imagine you are going on a trip to London in December. Write 3 sentences about what clothes you are going to need. Use "going to" in each sentence.


💡 Model Answer
1. I am going to need warm clothes because London is very cold in December.
2. I'm going to wear a thick coat, a scarf, and boots.
3. I think I'm going to buy gloves and a warm hat before I travel.
